title: TH17 cells contribute to uveitis and scleritis and are inhibited by IL-27/STAT1 in the retina \(1) Detection of TH17 cells in human blood
protocol: Transfer blood in heparin vacutainer tubes into a 50 ml BLUE MAXTM BD Falcon tube.
Carefully layer 30 ml of diluted blood over 12 ml of Isolymph without mixing layers.
Centrifuge for 30 minutes at 1,800 rpm at room temperature.
Harvest the buffy coat layer (whitish inter-phase layer containing PBMC) (~2-5 ml).
Transfer the harvested buffy coat to a fresh 50 ml Falcon tube and bring to 50 ml with PBS.
Wash twice in PBS by centrifugation for 10 minutes at 1,200 rpm at 4°C.
Suspend the pellet in 5 ml of cold complete medium and count cells using a hemacytometer.
Prepare fresh culture medium containing requisite antibiotics and serum.
Re-suspend PBMC or purified CD4+ T cells (1 X 10^6 per ml) in the presence or absence of IL-2 (100 u/ml), TGF-β1, IL-6, or IL-23 at 10 ng/ml, or IFN-γ at 100 U/ml.
Culture cells in a 24 well plate (2 ml per well) at 37°C for 4 days in 5% CO2.
Harvest culture supernatants (0.5 ml/well) for ELISA.
Gently harvest cells by pipetting up and down with a 2 ml serological pipette.
Transfer samples to 15 ml tubes and centrifuge at 1200 RPM (Sorvall Legend RT) for 10 minutes.
Activate PBMC or CD4+ T cells in the presence or absence of IL-2 for 4 days.
Stimulate cultures with PMA (20 ng/ml) and Ionomycin (1 mm) for 75 minutes.
Terminate the reaction by adding Golgistop to the cultures for an additional hour.
Transfer cells into 15 ml SARSTEDT tubes and wash cells twice in FACS buffer.
Suspend cells in FACS buffer at a concentration of 1-2 × 10^6/ml.
Transfer 1 ml aliquots (1-2 × 10^6 cells) into separate 5 ml Falcon tubes.
Centrifuge for 1,200 rpm for 10 minutes.
Perform intracellular staining using BD Cytofix/Cytoperm kit as suggested by manufacturer.
Subject stained cells to FACS analysis immediately or within 48 hours (keep cells at 4 °C).
Homogenize samples in 1 ml of TRIZOL reagent per 50-100 mg of tissue (<15 ml).
Transfer homogenized samples to Nalgene tubes and incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Add 0.25 ml of chloroform per 1 ml of TRIZOL reagent.
Shake vigorously by hand or vortex for 15 seconds.
Incubate at room temperature for 2-3 minutes.
Centrifuge at 12,000 g (about 9,000 rpm on SV600) for 15 minutes at 4 °C.
Transfer aqueous phase to fresh Nalgene tubes.
Add equal volume of isopropyl alcohol.
Mix well and incubate samples at room temperature for 10 minutes.
Centrifuge at 12,000 g for 10 minutes at 2-8°C.
Discard supernatant and add 1 ml of 75% ETOH to pellet.
Using a 2 ml pipette, scrape the RNA pellet away from tube into the ETOH.
Transfer ETOH/RNA mixture to fresh 1.5 ml eppendorf tube.
Rinse nalgene tube with more 75% ETOH and transfer to the eppendorf tube.
Bring the final volume of RNA/ETOH sample to 1.5 ml with 75% ETOH.
Centrifuge at max speed in refrigerated microfuge for 10 minutes.
Discard supernatant and add 500 μl 75% ETOH.
Centrifuge at 10,000 rpm in refrigerated microfuge for 5 minutes.
Pulse the sample and using P100 pipette carefully remove residual ETOH.
Air-dry RNA pellet for 15 minutes.
Redissolve RNA in DEPC treated water and store in aliquots at -70°C.
Determine RNA concentration using a spectrophotometer.
To 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube add the following (all RNA grade): RNA =X μl, 10X Buffer =50 μl, DNAse I =1 μl, DEPC Water =>500μl.
Digest for 20 minutes at 37°C.
Add 30 μl 20 mM EDTA (RNA grade) and heat at 95°C for 5 mins.
Phenol/chloroform extraction (1x): add 500 μl (Phenol/chloroform).
Vortex (1 minute) and centrifuge for 5 minutes at 14,000 rpm (RT).
Transfer aqueous phase (top) to another RNase-free 1.5 ml tube.
Add 400 μl of chloroform (with isoamyl alcohol).
Vortex for 1 minute and centrifuge for 5 minutes at 14,000 rpm (room temperature).
Transfer aqueous phase (top) to another RNase-free 1.5 ml tube.
Determine the volume of sample.
Add 1/9 volume of 3 M NaOAc, pH 5.2.
Add 2 volumes cold absolute (95-100%) alcohol.
Incubate on dry ice (or -70 °C) for 15 minutes.
Centrifuge at 4 °C, 14,000 rpm for 15 minutes.
Remove supernatant and add 500 μl of ice-cold 75% EtOH.
Incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Centrifuge at 4 °C, 14,000 rpm for 5 minutes.
Remove supernatant and add 500 μl of ice-cold 75% EtOH.
Incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Centrifuge at 4 °C, 14,000 rpm for 5 minutes.
Remove supernatant.
Spin for 30 seconds.
Remove supernatant with 100 μl pipetteman.
Air dry for 15 minutes.
Suspend in DEPC water.
Wipe down lab bench and pipetman with 10% H2O2 and change gloves frequently.
Mix all components briefly and spin down.
Preset heat blocks or thermocycler to 37 °C, 50 °C, and 70 °C respectively.
Into a 0.5 ml microcentrifuge tube add 27.5 μl RNA (1-10 μg).
Add 2.5 μl Oligo(dT) to each tube.
Incubate mixture at 70°C for 10 minutes.
Quench on ice for 1 minute and leave on ice.
Add 5 X First Strand buffer, 10 μl.
Add M DTT, 5.0 μl.
Add 10 mM dNTP, 2.5 μl.
Add RNAse out, 1.0 μl.
Incubate for 2 minutes at 50°C.
Add Superscript III, 2.5 μl.
Mix gently by tapping tubes, pulse.
Incubate at 50°C for 60 minutes.
Incubate at 70°C for 15 minutes to terminate reaction.
Incubate tubes at 37°C for 2 minutes.
Add RNase H, 1.0 μl (3.5 units).
Mix gently by tapping tubes.
Incubate at 37°C for 30 minutes.
Incubate samples at 95°C for 5 minutes.
Pulse samples by brief centrifugation.
Add 6 μl of 4 M LiCl to each tube, vortex and pulse.
Add 150 μl of cold (-20°C) absolute EtOH and vortex.
Freeze in dry ice for 30 minutes.
Spin at 14,000 rpm for 15 minutes and remove supernatant.
Add 150 μl of cold 75% EtOH.
Spin for 15 minutes as above and remove supernatant.
Air-dry for 15 minutes.
Suspend pellet in 50 μl of DEPC-treated H2O.
Incubate at 70°C, 10 minutes: to completely dissolve the pellet.
Save 0.5-1.0 μl for cDNA quantification.
Store at -20°C.
Verify integrity of RNA by Formamide electrophoresis using 1.5-2.0 μg RNA.
Incubate samples at 95°C for 10 min to activate AmpliTaq Gold.
Carry out amplification for 30-35 cycles of 30 s each at 95°C, 60°C, and 72°C.
Follow with a final 10-min extension at 72°C.
Perform real-time 5’-nuclease fluorogenic RT-PCR analysis on an ABI 7500 real-time PCR System using Taqman primer/probe sets.
Calculate relative levels of gene expression by extrapolation from standard curves generated using purified human IL-17 cDNA fragments.
Normalise the mRNA expression levels to the levels of ACTB and/or GAPDH housekeeping genes.
